stations.title: Hesper
stations.say: My drawings are lost in downloads.

stations.title: downloads
stations.text: Drawings, invoices and lists, all mixed up.
stations.note: One file at a time takes ages.

captions: At Ashgrove, Hesper's new drawings were saved into downloads, along with everything else.
Sorting the folder one file at a time would be slow and easy to get wrong.
You write patterns that pick out each group and move it in one go, in three tasks.
The drawings are in artwork, the invoices are filed, and Pellow Bakery has a folder.
A few characters name a whole group. downloads holds only what is left.
